2608.04271.title: LLM-based Vulnerability Discovery in Business Process Documentation
2608.04271.paper_summary: Just like software and hardware, business processes are susceptible to vulnerabilities that can lead to product quality issues, delays, and increased costs. Business process vulnerabilities can arise from a variety of sources, including conflicting requirements, ambiguous documentation, invalid measurement spec-ifications, omission of quality checks, or implementations that differ from speci-fications. MIRABELLE is a system that identifies and characterizes business logic (BL) vulnerabilities from available business process representations, in-cluding ISO 9000/9001 documentation, user guides, work instructions, and pro-cess execution logs. MIRABELLE leverages recent advances in AI/ML to pro-cess available business process documentation and generate attributed graph rep-resentations of the business logic that can be processed using both graph and for-mal logic approaches for identifying potential vulnerabilities. However, extract-ing the business logic (e.g., operation execution sequences, decisions, input/out-put resources) from mostly natural language artifacts is challenging due to the required domain expertise, inherent process complexity, and the sometimes very large volumes of information. This paper focuses on our experimentation with Large Language Models (LLMs) and their role within MIRABELLE. We report on the performance of several LLMs across vital stages of vulnerability detection, from grammatical and technical error-flagging in short phrasings, to complete process structure recovery and extraction.
2608.04271.paper_summary_zh: 就像軟體和硬體一樣，商業流程也容易受到漏洞的影響，這可能導致產品質量問題、延遲和成本增加。商業流程的漏洞可能來自多種來源，包括相互矛盾的需求、模糊的文件、不正確的測量規範、缺少質量檢查或與規範不同的實施。MIRABELLE是一個系統，能夠從可用的商業流程表示中識別和特徵化商業邏輯（BL）漏洞，包括ISO 9000/9001文件、用戶指南、工作指示和流程執行日誌。MIRABELLE利用最近在AI/ML方面的進展，處理可用的商業流程文件，並生成商業邏輯的屬性圖表示，這些表示可以使用圖形和形式邏輯方法來識別潛在漏洞。然而，從主要是自然語言的文檔中提取商業邏輯（例如，操作執行序列、決策、輸入/輸出資源）是具有挑戰性的，因為這需要專業領域的知識、固有的流程複雜性，以及有時非常龐大的信息量。本文專注於我們對大型語言模型（LLMs）的實驗及其在MIRABELLE中的角色。我們報告了幾個LLMs在漏洞檢測的關鍵階段的表現，從短語中的語法和技術錯誤標記，到完整的流程結構恢復和提取。
